task: The board is full of the same bug entered twice after that sync blew up and I want them gone
Which source files are carrying the most unresolved defects right now? I want the ranking, not a summary

arguments.query: SELECT f.path, COUNT(b.id) AS open_bugs FROM files f JOIN bugs b ON b.file_id = f.id WHERE b.status = 'open' GROUP BY f.path ORDER BY open_bugs DESC LIMIT 20
